sloka: तत्र यूयम् प्लवम् कृत्वा तरताम्शुमतीम् नदीम् ।ततो न्यग्रोधमासाद्य महान्तम् हरितच्छदम् ॥२-५५-६॥
transliteration: tatra yūyam plavam kṛtvā taratāmśumatīm nadīm ।tato nyagrodhamāsādya mahāntam haritacchadam ॥2-55-6॥

translations.english: There you will find a large, banyan tree with its lush green leaves, looking dark with its densely grown trees. It is inhabited by siddhas. Sita should offer with folded palms invocations for her wellbeing.
